title: upload_iso_policy_documents_validation
description: Test POST /api/audit/upload endpoint with valid ISO policy and evidence documents to ensure successful upload and 200 response confirmation.

title: upload_iso_policy_documents_invalid_format
description: Test POST /api/audit/upload endpoint with malformed or unsupported document data to verify it returns 400 or 415 error indicating upload validation failure.

title: start_iso_27001_audit_evaluation_success
description: Test POST /api/audit/start endpoint with valid session payload and usable evidence to confirm 200 response with ISO 27001 audit findings generated.

title: start_iso_27001_audit_evaluation_no_evidence
description: Test POST /api/audit/start endpoint without usable evidence to verify it returns 400 Bad Request due to insufficient audit input or zero-evidence guard.

title: upload_vapt_scan_logs_validation
description: Test POST /api/audit/upload endpoint with valid VAPT scan logs and technical evidence to ensure successful ingestion and 200 confirmation response.

title: upload_vapt_scan_logs_invalid_content
description: Test POST /api/audit/upload endpoint with corrupted logs or malicious file content to verify it returns 400 or 415 error from ingestion validation.

title: start_vapt_vulnerability_analysis_success
description: Test POST /api/audit/start endpoint with uploaded VAPT session context to confirm 200 response with VAPT findings, CVSS scoring, and control mappings.

title: start_vapt_vulnerability_analysis_no_valid_evidence
description: Test POST /api/audit/start endpoint with no valid technical evidence to verify it returns 400 Bad Request indicating the analysis cannot proceed.
